name: Innocence of a Match Girl
source:
It's New Year's Eve 1984, and your family is on the brink of homelessness... Again. Follow Christine as she naively takes on the task of earning rent money by selling matchbooks- a near impossible feat as your neighbors are still feeling the effects of a mysterious fire that broke out recently.

[From [url=https://springtime-creations.itch.io/innocence-of-a-match-girl]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是1984年的新年前夜，你的家人再次处于无家可归的边缘。跟随克里斯汀，她天真地承担起通过出售火柴盒赚取租金的任务——这几乎是不可能的壮举，因为你的邻居仍然感受到最近爆发的一场神秘火灾的影响。

[来自[url=https://springtime-creations.itch.io/innocence-of-a-match-girl]itch.io[/url]]
